title: REMOVE REAR END FRAME / REMOVE ROTOR FROM DRIVE END FRAME / INSPECTION OF ALTERNATOR

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear end frame with SST tool positioned on alternator

items: (b) Using SST, remove the rear end frame and four terminal insulators.

content.text: 6. REMOVE ROTOR FROM DRIVE END FRAME

content.description: Illustration showing rotor being removed from drive end frame

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, check for continuity between the slip rings.
If there is no continuity, replace the rotor.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter testing rotor for open circuit

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between the slip ring and the rotor. If there is continuity, replace the rotor.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter testing rotor for ground

items: (a) Check that the slip rings are not rough or scored. If rough or scored, replace the rotor.
(b) Using calipers, measure the slip ring diameter.

content.text: If the diameter of the slip ring is less than the minimum, replace the rotor.

content.description: Illustration showing calipers measuring slip ring diameter

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, check all leads for continuity. If there is no continuity, replace the drive end frame assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing stator inspection with multiple test lead positions
